",

  const makeImg = src => { const img = new Image(); img.src = src; return img; };
  const HD_L1 = {
    bg: makeImg(HD_L1_SRC.bg),

  function level1AssetsReady(){
    return Object.values(HD_L1).every(img => img && img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0);
  }
  let level1PreloadPromise = null;
  function preloadLevel1HD(){
    if(level1AssetsReady()) return Promise.resolve(true);
    if(level1PreloadPromise) return level1PreloadPromise;
    level1PreloadPromise = Promise.all(Object.values(HD_L1).map(img => new Promise(resolve => {
      if(img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) return resolve(true);
      const done = () => resolve(true);
      const fail = () => resolve(false);
      img.addEventListener('load', done, {once:true});
      img.addEventListener('error', fail, {once:true});
      if(img.decode) img.decode().then(done).catch(()=>{});
    }))).then(results => results.every(Boolean) && level1AssetsReady()).catch(()=>false);
    return level1PreloadPromise;
  }
  preloadLevel1HD();
